assessment: This manuscript describes the use of genome editing screens to identify mechanisms underlying resistance to the hypomethylating anti-cancer agent decitabine, an activity-based inhibitor of the DNA methyltransferase DNMT1. A specific focus is given to the development of tools and approaches to identify allosteric mechanisms of resistance that emerge, including those that appear to act as gain-of-function mutations in DNMT1 and its interacting partner UHRF1. These findings showcase the power of large-scale genome editing for uncovering novel resistance mechanisms and investigating protein allostery.
